title: Estimating Performance for Safe Deployment of Machine Learning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The main challenge in applying deep neural networks to real-world scenarios lies in distributional discrepancies between training and test datasets, often caused by variations in data acquisition conditions. Assessing the performance of pre-trained models without labels is crucial for safety, but this is complicated by deep models' overly optimistic probabilistic outputs, often exacerbated by class imbalances, leading to unreliable predictions. To address these issues, we introduce MOVAL, a novel MOdel eVALuation tool that estimates performance using unlabeled test data. MOVAL incorporates class-wise confidence calibration to adjust model outputs, allowing for the estimation of metrics beyond accuracy and mitigating the detrimental effects of class imbalance on confidence calibration. Additionally, we propose an ensemble approach that combines multiple calibrated confidence scores for a more robust solution. We validate MOVAL on natural

translated_title: 面向机器学习模型安全部署的性能估计方法
translated_abstract: 将深度神经网络应用于现实场景的主要挑战在于训练数据集与测试数据集之间的分布差异，这通常是由数据获取条件的变化引起的。在没有标签的情况下评估预训练模型的性能对于安全性至关重要，但深度模型过于乐观的概率输出使这一问题变得复杂，而类不平衡往往进一步加剧了这一问题，导致不可靠的预测。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MOVAL，一种新颖的模型评估工具，它利用未标记的测试数据来估计模型性能。MOVAL结合了按类别的置信度校准来调整模型输出，从而不仅能够估计准确率之外的指标，还能减轻类不平衡对置信度校准的不利影响。此外，我们提出了一种集成方法，将多个校准后的置信度分数相结合，以获得更稳健的解决方案。我们在自然（图像数据集上验证了MOVAL的有效性）。
tldr: 提出了MOVAL模型评估工具，通过类别级置信度校准与多校准分数集成方法，利用无标签测试数据估计模型性能，从而实现机器学习模型的安全部署。
en_tdlr: Proposes MOVAL, a novel model evaluation tool that estimates performance from unlabeled test data via class-wise confidence calibration and an ensemble of multiple calibrated confidence scores, enabling safe deployment of machine learning models under distribution shift and class imbalance.
